episode.logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
episode.continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 45's cliffhanger where the High Priest stormed into the church with royal guards and challenged the legality of Alexander and Juliana's marriage.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Full shot of Alexander and Juliana standing side by side before the altar, their hands tightly clasped beneath the soaring stained-glass windows.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Alexander holds Juliana's hand resolutely as Juliana gazes toward the church aisle where the intrusion unfolds.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of an elderly noblewoman seated in the pew, clutching her chest with anxious apprehension.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine in her lavish bridal gown, her fists clenched tightly in silent fury.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide tracking shot down the ruined nave aisle as the High Priest marches forward flanked by armed royal guards with halberds.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Heavy armored footsteps and boots crunching against loose stone debris.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Authoritative):
events.text: "By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Commanding):
events.text: "None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Cold, Accusatory):
events.text: "You married this woman as a nameless beggar..."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scornful, Harsh):
events.text: "...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Resonant, Dismissive):
events.text: "Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Gravely, Firm):
events.text: "She married the man... not the title."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Derisive):
events.text: "The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Rigid, Formal):
events.text: "No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Sharp):
events.text: "No licensed clergyman presided..."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scathing):
events.text: "...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer."

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Thundering):
events.text: "And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant):
events.text: "I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.

events.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute):
events.text: "I won't ask it for permission to love."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Condescending, Venomous):
events.text: "Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

events.label: JULIANA (Accusatory, Pained):
events.text: "Then look at this floor honestly, for once."

events.label: JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Passionate):
events.text: "A church called me unworthy."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

events.label: JULIANA (O.S.) (Bitter):
events.text: "A church chained me."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

events.label: JULIANA (Furious, Resolute):
events.text: "Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"

events.label: JULIANA (Shouting, Triumphant):
events.text: "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.

events.label: CATHERINE (Malicious, Taunting):
events.text: "Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S. / Low, Threatening):
events.text: "Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe):
events.text: "God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Threatening):
events.text: "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute):
events.text: "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Unflinching):
events.text: "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Defiant, Commanding):
events.text: "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Chilling, Victorious):
events.text: "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."

events.label: ALEXANDER (Steely, Unfazed):
events.text: "I'll take that wager over your decree."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing):
events.text: "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.

events.label: HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning):
events.text: "Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.

events.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Malicious):
events.text: "Ten days is plenty of time."
